# Design-General Versus Rejection-Specific Fields

| Field | Every design | Selected rejection family |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Exact probability law or deterministic finite measure | Required | Independent symmetric base law conditioned on exact admission. |
| Stable population/order and assignment alphabet | Required | Exact ordered active detector domain; `{-1,+1}`. |
| Probabilities/weights and relations | Required | Uniform admitted-vector target; equal member weights; duplicate/complement relations separate. |
| Counts, ranks, null spaces | Applicable values required | Six counts; uncentered `r_sign`; named `r_map`; applicable null spaces. |
| Reconstruction, lifecycle, generation, completion, failure | Required | Content-bound scheduling-independent generator/key and fail-closed resolution. |
| Preregistration | Every applicable field before output inspection | All controls, including stochastic fields, frozen before inspection. |
| RNG/version | `not_applicable` unless used | Required and exact. |
| Seed/key bytes | `not_applicable` unless used | Required and exact. |
| Tolerance | `not_applicable` unless used | Exact `tau_h in [0,1)`, no default. |
| Retry cap | `not_applicable` unless used | Positive, exact, preregistered. |
| Rejected-candidate count | `not_applicable` unless candidates can reject | Required diagnostic fact; rejected candidates never become members. |
